lastCommit.message:
[ota-hal] OTA-1726 — the road back to a dog

Audit item D1, closed against your canon instead of left as a question.

⚠⚠⚠ THE ONLY ROAD BACK TO A DOG WAS A DEAD END BY CONSTRUCTION. Not half-built —
unfinishable. The puppy vendor ends with the Arbiter saying:

    "Type 'accept puppy' or 'decline puppy'."

Neither phrase has a parser verb or a handler anywhere in the app. The ONLY
occurrence of the string in the whole codebase is inside that instruction. The
trade wrote a `puppy_vendor_trade_id:` memo for handlers that do not exist —
its sibling `dog_rescue_pending:` IS read, so the pattern was known and this one
was simply never finished. Nobody has ever completed that trade.

⚠⚠ AND IT COULD LOCK YOU OUT OF DOGS PERMANENTLY. Its no-tradeable-item branch
set `puppyVendorUsed: true` and retired itself forever. A player whose pack was
empty when the offer fired lost access to a companion for the rest of that save
— the exact opposite of "loss of an individual dog does not permanently remove
access to dogs." A fourth defect on the same mechanism: the offer path cleared
`puppyVendorQueued` but never set `used` nor cleared `owed`, contradicting its
own doc comment, so the offer re-fired on any mention of a basket or a stranger,
without limit.

⚠ SO IT WAS SUPERSEDED, NOT REPAIRED. Wiring up `accept puppy` would have made
reachable a mechanism that contradicts your canon three ways at once: single-
shot, near-free (one Common item), and gated on death rather than open on the
same terms every time. Repairing it would have been building the wrong thing
well. It is out; the rubble puppy — a genuine one-off story beat, all Guardians
cleared — stays.

⚠⚠⚠ AND THE ARCHITECTURE ALREADY SUPPORTED YOUR CANON. I looked for the reason
to escalate this to Fable and did not find one. Four things were already true:

  · acquisition funnels through ONE field, `pendingDogOnboarding`, and
    `confirmDogOnboarding` rebuilds `player.dog` WHOLESALE from a fresh
    `createDogCompanion` — so "a replacement inherits nothing: not identity,
    bond, progression, equipment, history or status" was already structurally
    guaranteed. There is nowhere for the old dog to leak through.
  · FIVE stat profiles were already authored and differentiated — mongrel
    10/10/10, shepherd STR 12, hound DEX 12, mutt INT 12, puppy. "Faction dogs
    remain better and specialised" needed no new content, only the assignment.
  · `buyFromVendor` already had TWO branches for buying a thing that is not an
    item (procedure texts → knownTechniques, recipes → knownRecipes). The dog is
    a third of the same shape, and the procedure branch already wrote down why:
    a thing that mints into the pack needs a catalog row, a `use` handler and a
    read path before it does anything — three more places for the loop to end in
    nothing.
  · conditional vendor rows already had TWO precedents with an explicit "same
    shape, same place, append one row" contract (`withSkyreacherChartOffer`,
    `withTechniqueTextOffer`).

Third instance of each. That is why this is an OTA and not a Fable escalation.

THE MARKET:

    Kennel Dog ............ 600 TC · mongrel · any vendor
    Tartarian War Shepherd  900 TC · shepherd · True Tartarians + rapport
    Reclaimer's Scent Hound 900 TC · hound    · Reclaimers Guild + rapport
    Order's Seeker ........ 900 TC · mutt     · Forgotten Order + rapport

⚠ 600 IS NOT A GUESSED NUMBER AND NOT A NEW RUNG. `techniqueTextPrice` has
charged exactly 600 TC for a Rare aether procedure since OTA-1195 — the game's
other "this is the only route into a whole feature" purchase — so your figure
lands on a price the economy already carries. Measured against a real purse:
your most recent log has you holding 459 TC. It is a sum you have to go and earn.

⚠ NO DIE ROLL, deliberately, and on the reason OTA-1195 already recorded: a
route into a whole feature that appears 18% of the time is indistinguishable
from a route that does not exist. The chart offer rolls because a chart is a
bonus; this is the only way back to a companion. It rides on the ROADSIDE STALL
as well as named vendors, because the stall is the vendor source the file itself
calls dominant ("a stall every ~5 travel steps") — a market only at hubs is a
market most players never walk into.

⚠ THE FIRST-DOG ENCOUNTER IS STILL THE INTRODUCTION. The market is invisible
until `player.dog` is non-null — which OTA-346 keeps set for a dead or abandoned
dog, so it reads exactly "has ever had a dog". Without that gate a new character
could buy past five authored rescue scenarios.

⚠ NEGLECT STILL BUYS NOTHING. OTA-1717's rule survives the supersede, and the
suite pins it: the loyalty-zero branch does not touch any owed flag.

⚠ ONE THING I LEFT FOR YOU. The rubble puppy is a FREE dog, late-game, once all
nine Guardians are down. It is working authored content and deleting it on my
own reading of the canon would exceed what you asked for. A free pup coexisting
with a 600 TC market is a balance question, not a defect — your call.

23 tests, 18 gates green, complete surface clean. gameStore lost 60 lines net.
The canon is written into CLAUDE.md so the next model does not have to
rediscover it.
